title: Happy New Year, Everyone!

body: A note of sincere thanks – to all who followed me on Facebook, Twitter, and my blog in 2015. I’m deeply grateful for your interest and I look forward to an even better year next year … as we seek to do justice, love kindness, and walk humbly with God. My prayer for you is that your heart fills up and overflows with love, joy, peace, and generosity … so that you are blessed and a great blessing to others near and far. Happy New Year, everyone!
